Evening Meal—Makeover 3
Original Meal
8-ounce grilled steak
1 medium baked potato
2 Tblsp sour cream
1 cup green peas and onions
1 dinner roll
1 tsp butter
1 piece frosted devils’ food cake
Coffee—regular or decaffeinated
Meal analysis: 1,480 calories, 64 g fat, 32 g saturated fat, 
230 mg cholesterol, 5 g fiber, 1,203 mg sodium 
Modified Meal
Steak with steamed vegetables 
and soba noodles
1 seven-grain roll
1 Tblsp honey
1 star fruit, sliced over 1/2 cup sherbet
2 fortune cookies
Green tea
Meal analysis: 900 calories, 24 g fat, 9 g saturated fat, 
70 mg cholesterol, 14 g fiber, 1,040 mg sodium
Cook steak —grill, broil, or fry in a non-stick pan until medium rare.  Set aside on covered platter to keep warm.  Cook
soba noodles according to package directions.  While noodles are cooking, steam the vegetables until tender crisp.  Combine
sauce ingredients, heat through.
